cases.steps: Use Tab from document through cancellation, Enter to dismiss confirm, Space to accept, Tab after reload
cases.expected: Keyboard can reach control; visible focus; native dialog closes without trap; focus returns on dismissal; new document navigation remains operable
cases.actual: Tab reached action; Enter dismissed; Space accepted; focus returned on dismissal and reset to BODY on successful document reload; subsequent Tab works

cases.steps: Inspect live Chromium accessibility tree before and during actual rejected cancellation; inspect polite status mutation
cases.expected: Control has accessible Vietnamese name, help description and live status semantics exposed by browser
cases.actual: Actual Chromium AX tree exposes named/described button and polite atomic live status; real 403 message appears in AX StaticText

button.name: Hủy đơn hàng
button.description: Bạn có thể hủy đơn hàng khi cửa hàng chưa xác nhận.

cases.feedback: Bạn không có quyền hủy đơn hoặc phiên bảo mật đã hết hạn. Hãy tải lại trang hoặc đăng nhập lại.

cases.steps: Observe actual audible assistive-technology announcement
cases.expected: Human screen-reader verification of labels and announcement timing
cases.actual: Headless Chromium exposes AX semantics, but this environment has no connected screen reader. Audio announcement was not observed. AX semantics were separately verified.

cases.steps: Operate native confirmation entirely using physical Tab/Enter/Escape and observe native focus
cases.expected: Actual native dialog keyboard focus, no trap, and focus return
cases.actual: Playwright native dialog accept/dismiss and page focus return were executed, but headless Chromium provides no OS-native dialog surface for physical Tab/Enter/Escape observation.

cases.steps: Inspect native browser confirmation visually at 375, 768 and 1440px and capture dialog screenshots
cases.expected: Native confirmation text and buttons fit and are legible at every requested width
cases.actual: Native confirm events, message and accept/dismiss executed at each width. Renderer screenshots capture the page, not browser-native dialog chrome; native dialog visual evidence requires headed desktop observation.

cases.steps: Log in through real login form; use GET-rendered masked CSRF with auth cookie; click cancel
cases.expected: Actual authenticated browser request succeeds with correct ID/version and valid CSRF
cases.actual: Real authenticated cookie + rendered masked CSRF POST returned 200; page reloaded CANCELLED

cases.steps: Intercept outgoing real cancellation request only to missing CSRF header; let actual server respond
cases.expected: Server returns 403, safe security feedback and no domain mutation
cases.actual: Real server 403; denied command changed no order/stock/voucher/history/inbox/payment; reload with fresh CSRF recovered
cases.feedback: Bạn không có quyền hủy đơn hoặc phiên bảo mật đã hết hạn. Hãy tải lại trang hoặc đăng nhập lại.

cases.steps: Intercept outgoing real cancellation request only to invalid CSRF header; let actual server respond
cases.expected: Server returns 403, safe security feedback and no domain mutation
cases.actual: Real server 403; denied command changed no order/stock/voucher/history/inbox/payment; reload with fresh CSRF recovered
cases.feedback: Bạn không có quyền hủy đơn hoặc phiên bảo mật đã hết hạn. Hãy tải lại trang hoặc đăng nhập lại.

cases.steps: Keep original signed cookie in old tab; perform real POST logout in another tab; replay original cookie without altering it; click stale cancellation; reauthenticate
cases.expected: Revoked signed session returns 401 without domain mutation; login recovery works
cases.actual: Actual logout token-version revocation rejected original signed cookie with 401; real reauthentication recovered
cases.feedback: Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.

cases.steps: Run identical JAR with isolated signing key and stricter 5-second TTL/zero skew; real login; retain original signed cookie past expiry; click cancellation; reauthenticate
cases.expected: Server rejects truly expired JWT with 401; no mutation; fresh session recovers
cases.actual: Original, unmodified server-signed JWT was expired by server clock and returned 401; reauthentication enabled successful cancellation
cases.configuration: Same exact JAR, TTL PT5S and clock-skew PT0S, own generated key; browser retention extended but JWT claims/signature unchanged
cases.feedback: Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.

cases.steps: Double-click actual enabled control while real request is held in transit; accept native confirm; release request
cases.expected: Exactly one POST, one version increment and one inventory/voucher restoration
cases.actual: Physical browser mouse double-click emitted one cancellation POST; disabled control prevented a second submission

cases.steps: Cancel through UI then send repeated browser POST with original and current versions; reload
cases.expected: Replays return 409 and cannot repeat restoration or notifications
cases.actual: Both repeated submissions returned real 409; committed effects stayed byte-for-byte equal in selected state

cases.steps: Load same NEW order in two real tabs; cancel first; attempt second stale UI; follow reload link
cases.expected: First returns 200; second returns 409 with safe message; reload removes action and shows CANCELLED
cases.actual: Actual two-tab race returned 200 then 409; reload reconciled persisted cancellation without duplicate effects
cases.feedback: Đơn hàng đã thay đổi hoặc không còn có thể hủy. Hãy tải lại trang để xem trạng thái mới nhất.

cases.steps: Foreign authenticated Buyer GETs real order ID then POSTs cancel with their own valid CSRF
cases.expected: Both GET and POST return 404 with no cancellation control or domain changes
cases.actual: Foreign Buyer GET 404 and POST 404; no action and no mutation

cases.steps: Authenticated Buyer requests absent positive Long order ID via GET and POST with valid CSRF
cases.expected: 404 and no action, no mutation of existing orders
cases.actual: Missing order GET 404 and POST 404

cases.steps: Load own eligible order, redirect outgoing cancellation to missing order ID while preserving genuine request/token; actual backend returns 404
cases.expected: Frontend renders generic missing/no-access message without false success; original order unchanged
cases.actual: Real backend missing-order 404 rendered generic safe feedback; original order unchanged. Request URL fault injection only; response was not mocked.
cases.feedback: Không tìm thấy đơn hàng hoặc bạn không có quyền truy cập. Vui lòng quay lại danh sách đơn hàng.

cases.steps: Seller confirms NEW order through real vendor form; Buyer reloads; direct Buyer cancel uses valid CSRF
cases.expected: CONFIRMED order has no Buyer action; server rejects cancellation with 409 without effects
cases.actual: Actual Vendor confirmation produced CONFIRMED; Buyer action absent; real Buyer POST returned 409

cases.steps: VENDOR-only account places own order; opens Buyer detail; directly calls Buyer cancel with valid CSRF
cases.expected: No Buyer control even on owned NEW order; server returns 403
cases.actual: VENDOR-only owned NEW detail returned 200 without Buyer cancellation control; direct Buyer endpoint returned 403

cases.steps: Open eligible detail online; switch browser context offline; cancel; return online and reload before retry
cases.expected: No false success; safe uncertain feedback; no original server mutation; reload allows one safe cancellation
cases.actual: Chromium offline produced net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED, uncertain feedback and disabled action; online reload/retry committed once
cases.feedback: Chưa xác nhận được kết quả hủy. Hãy tải lại trang để kiểm tra trước khi thử lại.

cases.steps: Abort browser transport with connectionreset; inspect state; reload and retry
cases.expected: Network failure does not claim success or enable blind retry; reconciliation preserves one cancellation
cases.actual: Real browser transport aborted before server dispatch; no domain effect; uncertain message then online reconciliation and one successful cancellation
cases.feedback: Chưa xác nhận được kết quả hủy. Hãy tải lại trang để kiểm tra trước khi thử lại.

cases.steps: Hold real PostgreSQL Order row lock; dispatch real UI request; observe blocked backend via pg_stat_activity; switch browser offline; release lock; reload online
cases.expected: Actual request outcome and navigation failure are recorded; persisted outcome reconciles after online reload without double restoration
cases.actual: Real PostgreSQL lock waiter proved in-flight request. Chromium offline did not abort the existing HTTP stream: actual 200 was delivered and cancellation committed; automatic GET reload failed offline with browser error. Explicit online reload reconciled CANCELLED. No uncertain-feedback assertion is made for an already delivered 200.

cases.steps: Send genuine request through route.fetch; assert actual backend 200 and committed DB effects; discard response with connectionreset; reload then replay
cases.expected: Lost success response never claims success or retries automatically; reload discovers CANCELLED; replay returns 409 with unchanged effects
cases.actual: Actual committed 200 intentionally lost in network; UI stayed uncertain and disabled; reload found CANCELLED; repeat returned 409 with exactly one restoration/history/notification set
cases.feedback: Chưa xác nhận được kết quả hủy. Hãy tải lại trang để kiểm tra trước khi thử lại.

environment.scope: Loopback-only disposable PostgreSQL; synthetic accounts; real packaged Spring application and Chromium; no mocked success responses
environment.cleanup: Owned disposable application processes stopped; owned ephemeral database container removed
